E15.definition: Delta_k(H)=min{m-n:2<=n<m<=H and both coefficient-safe for k steps}

recursive_difference_rule.deletion_rule: when an unsafe point is deleted, its two adjacent gaps merge by exact addition
recursive_difference_rule.nested_sets: Safe_(k+1) is a subset of Safe_k

strict_growth_shortcut.hypothesis: Delta_(k+1)(H)>Delta_k(H) whenever both values are defined
strict_growth_shortcut.surviving_rule: Delta_(k+1)(H)>=Delta_k(H) whenever both values are defined

what_this_result_does_not_prove: Finite spacing through H=1500000 gives no lower bound at H=2^72 or depth K0-1; disappearance of pairs in the scanned prefix is not a spacing theorem.
